newsitem.title: USA: Geotek in marketing pact with IBM.
newsitem.headline: Geotek in marketing pact with IBM.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc said Wednesday it had agreed to allow International Business Machines Corp to market Geotek wireless voice and data services nationwide.
Under terms of the pact, IBM will market Geoteks services along with its own services, and will provide customer support in all of Geotek's U.S. markets, Geotek said.

"This agreement will enable us to provide customers with the highest quality products and service as we expand our networks across the U.S.," Geotek President and Chief Operating Officer Jonathan Crane said in a statement.
The agreement is part of a continuing relationship between the two companies.
